task.question: Who inaugurated the Noida International Airport in India in March 2026?
task.evidence: 28 March – The Noida International Airport is inaugurated by Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

answer:
Noida International Airport, also known as Jewar Airport, in India was inaugurated on 28 March 2026. The event was presided over by Prime Minister Narendra Modi. 

FINAL: Narendra Modi.

[Noida International Airport] Noida International Airport (IATA: DXN, ICAO: VIND), also called Jewar Airport, is an international airport at Jewar in the Gautam Buddha Nagar district of Uttar Pradesh, India, serving the National Capital Region and western Uttar Pradesh. In its first phase, the airport has one runway and one passenger terminal with a capacity of 12 million passengers annually. The airport will increase this capacity to 30 million passengers annually in the upcoming years. The airport is intended to complement Indira Gandhi International Airport as part of the Delhi-NCR region's dual-airport system. The first phase was inaugurated on 28 March 2026, following the grant of an aerodrome licence by the DGCA on 6 March 2026. Commercial operations began on 15 June 2026. On 9 October 2026, the Cabinet of Uttar Pradesh approved a proposal to rename the airport Narendra Modi International Airport after Prime Minister Narendra Modi. | other articles: Noida, Noida Metro

[Noida] Noida, short for New Okhla Industrial Development Authority, is a city located in Gautam Buddha Nagar district in the Indian state of Uttar Pradesh. It is a part of the National Capital Region (NCR). Situated in the floodplain region between the Yamuna and the Hindon rivers, the city was established in 1976, and is regarded as one of the most systematically planned cities in India. It was designed under the NCR planning strategy to decentralise growth from Delhi. The Gautam Buddha Nagar District, which includes the cities of Noida, Greater Noida and YEIDA City contributes, over 10% to the Uttar Pradesh GSDP, more than 2.5 times the state capital district of Lucknow, which contributes 4%. It is India’s 4th richest City by GDP per capita as per FY2024-25 behind only Rangareddy (Telangana), Gurugram (Haryana) and Bengaluru Urban (Karnataka). Noida is frequently ranked as one of India's greenest cities, boasting over 50% green cover, including botanical gardens and biodiversity parks. The city emphasises sustainable development, green corridors, and high-quality landscaping. As per provisional reports of Census of India, the population of Noida in 2011 was 642,381.
